name: figmento
description: Figmento — AI-powered design tools for Figma

scripts.dev: concurrently -n relay,plugin -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix figmento-ws-relay" "npm run watch --prefix figmento"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix figmento-mcp-server && npm run build --prefix figmento && npm run build --prefix figmento-ws-relay
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix figmento-mcp-server && npm run lint --prefix figmento && npm run lint --prefix figmento-ws-relay
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/figmento-core && npm run typecheck --prefix figmento
scripts.test: npm test --prefix figmento-mcp-server && npm test --prefix figmento
